work_order: F1M: suspected inverter fault (IGBT) (model confidence 1.0), detected at t=8.4s. Estimated loss 196.1 W, about 0.98 kWh/day if left unrepaired. Action: Isolate the inverter, check IGBT gate drivers and DC-link capacitors, replace the faulty module. Assign: electrician + inverter OEM.

F5M: suspected PV array open circuit (model confidence 0.94), detected at t=7.9s. Estimated loss 188.5 W, about 0.942 kWh/day if left unrepaired. Action: Locate the open string with string-level current checks; repair connectors or cabling. Assign: O&M crew.

F2M: suspected feedback sensor fault (model confidence 1.0), detected at t=8.7s. Estimated loss 0.1 W, about 0.0 kWh/day if left unrepaired. Action: Compare the phase-voltage sensor against a calibrated meter; recalibrate or replace the sensor. Assign: instrumentation tech.

F6M: suspected boost converter controller fault (PI gain) (model confidence 1.0), detected at t=12.2s. Estimated loss 3.3 W, about 0.016 kWh/day if left unrepaired. Action: Review boost-converter PI controller settings against commissioning values; restore and retest. Assign: controls engineer.

F7M: suspected boost converter controller fault (model confidence 0.8), detected at t=11.2s. Estimated loss 0.0 W, about 0.0 kWh/day if left unrepaired. Action: Run controller diagnostics on the boost converter; reflash firmware or replace the control board. Assign: controls engineer.
